changelog.summary: Accepts findings from SEO and AI Visibility Intelligence in addition to funnel and lifecycle sources.

title: Growth Experimentation and Follow-Through
description: Generate prioritized experiment hypotheses from growth findings, create tracked Linear, Slack, and CRM actions, and verify whether shipped changes actually improved their KPI — your AI Growth Analyst's action loop.
setup_prompt: Use Growth Experimentation and Follow-Through for my AI Growth Analyst. Turn my supported findings into prioritized hypotheses, create tracked actions only in my authorized tools, require my approval for launches and customer-facing changes, and verify each shipped change against its pre-registered KPI target.

setup_inputs.label: Finding sources with evidence and confidence
Rollout, rollback, and launch approval ownership
KPI targets, readout windows, and notification policy

recommended_tools.name: Linear or Jira MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Create and track approved experiment and follow-up tasks with evidence links

recommended_tools.name: Notification MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Publish approved alerts, readout summaries, and review requests to customer channels and retain delivery receipts

recommended_tools.name: HubSpot or Customer.io MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Create approved CRM segments and campaign audiences from verified experiment cohorts

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks workflow database
recommended_tools.purpose: Persist hypotheses, experiments, actions, KPI snapshots, and readout verdicts

pulse_focus.label: Strategic review
focus_areas: Whether experiments compound into growth outcomes
Learning rate, prioritization quality, and decision value
review_when: Outcome metrics regress, priorities change, or the current approach needs periodic challenge

outputs: Prioritized experiment backlog with evidence links
Learning history and live experimentation report
